component.subject: Illumination
component.title: Prayer for Illumination
component.author: Mozarabic Rite
component.source: Mozarabic collect, in William Bright, Ancient Collects (third edition, 1864), "Prayers for Various Graces: For Sacred Knowledge", p. 78.

original.p: Show the light of Thy countenance upon us, Lord, that the going-forth of Thy word may give light and understanding, to nourish the hearts of the simple; and that while our desire is set on Thy commandments, we may receive with open heart the Spirit of wisdom and understanding.

block.p: Show the light of your countenance upon us, Lord, that the going-forth of your Word may give light and understanding, to nourish the hearts of the humble; and that while our desire is set on your commandments, we may receive with open heart your spirit of wisdom and understanding.
